sequence: Preinstall two inserts on detached bridge; bearing seated before head insertion.
Side-load C keeper onto detached yaw drive seat.
Lower keeper and yaw drive seat together; pitch cradle/head absent, reaction link released/travelling together.
Turn yaw seat +60deg to expose both screw axes; install two M3x8 screws downward with long-leg2AF key.
Return yaw to zero, then fit pitch cradle/head.
Removal: remove pitch assembly, undo keeper screws, release reaction connection and lift keeper with yaw seat.
